ability.name: Step 0 — Machine Context Check
ability.description: Examine the local foothold identity, token privileges, group memberships, and network adapters to map multi-homed interfaces and privilege context.

stages.command_template: $d='C:/Windows/Temp/bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $id = whoami /all; $priv = whoami /priv; $cs = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem; $dom = $cs.PartOfDomain; $dn = $cs.Domain; $os = (Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem).Caption; $hn = $env:COMPUTERNAME; $adapters = Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' -and $_.PrefixLength -lt 32 } | ForEach-Object { $ip = $_.IPAddress; $pl = $_.PrefixLength; $b = ([System.Net.IPAddress]$ip).GetAddressBytes(); $mk = [System.BitConverter]::GetBytes([uint32]([Math]::Pow(2,32)-[Math]::Pow(2,32-$pl))); if ([BitConverter]::IsLittleEndian) { [Array]::Reverse($mk) }; $net = (0..3|ForEach-Object{$b[$_]-band $mk[$_]}) -join '.'; "ADAPTER: $($_.InterfaceAlias)  IP: $ip  CIDR: $net/$pl" }; Write-Output "PLATFORM: windows"; Write-Output "HOSTNAME: $hn"; Write-Output "DOMAIN_JOINED: $dom"; Write-Output "DOMAIN: $dn"; Write-Output "OS: $os"; $adapters | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI_ALL ---"; $id; Write-Output "--- WHOAMI_PRIV ---"; $priv } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: step0_windows $($_.Exception.Message)" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d/step0.txt

rationale: Gather host-level context to check domain affiliation, multi-homed interfaces, and privileges.
